The '''Keshtah Chronicles''' was a [[Book/Legends|tome]] [[Writing/Legends|written]] by [[Adari Vaal]], a fugitive from the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], during her [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] on the continent of [[Alanciar]]. The ''Chronicles'' comprised all of her teachings that she bestowed upon the previously-isolated [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] of Alanciar, including descriptions of her homeland, [[Keshtah Minor|Keshtah]], and of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].
